page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Main text in one column. Notes in the right margin, beside the text. Catchword and signature at bottom right.

main_text.l: Tertium West-Saxonum, fundatum A.C. 519 à Cerdicio :
Quartum East-Saxonum, fundatum A. C. 547. ab Ida:
Sextum East-Anglorum, fundatum A.C. 574. ab Uffa:
Septimum Merciorum, fundatum A. C. 656. à Penda.
main_text.p: Canon 2. Inter hos septem Reges Anglo-Saxonum semper penesMonarchicè tamen; unum aliquem Monarchia fuit.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Id quod testatur Beda l. 7. Illa vero Monarchia fuit ambulatoria, modò penes hanc, modò penes aliam gentem, non successione vel electione, sed armis ac potentia quaerenda.
main_text.head: Periodus II.
main_text.p: Can. I. Septem regna Anglo-Sa-donec hæc regna in unum imperium coaluerunt.

page.notes: The right margin has two notes: "Monarchicè tamen;" beside "penes", and "donec hæc regna in unum imperium coaluerunt." beside the last line. Their print is partly worn; the note wording is read as best possible. The catchword "xo-" is printed at the foot right and continues the hyphenated word "Sa-". Several kingdom lines are italic in the printed original (e.g. Ida, Uffa, Penda, Beda, Explicatio); the italic type is not marked here.
